children: shares traded lower in premarket falling approximately 10% to $13.51 following the release of its

, weighed down by a top-line revenue miss and a widening GAAP net loss, primarily driven by lower fresh lemon sales volumes caused by higher U.S. lemon imports and the ongoing transition of citrus brokerage operations to Sunkist.
Q3 total net revenue fell 7.8% Y/Y to $43.81M (down from $47.5M in Q3 FY25), missing consensus estimates by $5.82M.
GAAP net loss widened to $3M, or $(0.17) per share, compared to a net loss of $1M, or $(0.06) per share, in the prior-year period. Non-GAAP EPS came in at $0.02, missing expectations of $0.19.
Fresh lemon sales generated $27.3M (1.373M cartons at $19.88/carton). Due to high import volumes in the U.S., management expects full-year lemon volume to land at the lower end of prior guidance.

The selling pressure comes despite positive underlying metrics, including a 30% Y/Y rise in Non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA to $3.9M, raised FY26 avocado volume guidance (7.0M–7.25M lbs), and confirmation of its $15M Windfall Farms cash sale via a competitive public auction.
Limoneira confirmed its Colorado River water rights monetization plan remains on track for completion in fiscal year 2026.

title: Limoneira shares fall after Q3 revenue miss and widening net loss
